lines.text: Wait! The Night Leo Skipped Brushing His Teeth (Cartoon!)!
Most kids guess totally wrong about why brush teeth at night!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Saliva slows down at bedtime while mouth bacteria eat leftover.
sugar and release acid that slowly wears away strong tooth enamel.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Sugar Bug Party!
